conditions.title: Approval conditions
conditions.empty: No approval conditions on this financing.

waiver.title: A waiver needs a second approver
waiver.description: This does not lift the condition. It asks for approval, and the request appears in Pending approvals — the condition stays open until someone else approves it.
waiver.requested: Waiver requested — it now needs a second approver.

termsUnavailable.title: Contract terms could not be loaded

truncated.title: Not all contracts are shown
truncated.description: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} contracts in this request.

contracts.shareUndecided: No financing exists on this case yet, so no contract carries a share of a loan.

shareUnavailable.title: The loan shares could not be loaded

data.noFinancing: This case has no financing yet. A financing is created when the refinancing request is approved — it cannot be created directly.

figuresPending.title: Figures are still being calculated
figuresPending.description: The amounts below are provisional and will change once the calculation completes.

covenants.title: Approval conditions
covenants.empty: No approval conditions were attached to this financing.

noFinancing.title: No financing yet
noFinancing.description: A financing exists once the refinancing request has been approved. Until then there is nothing to calculate.

calculation.readOnlyNotice: You can read these figures. Entering and changing the rate is the preparing role's task.

rate.label: Refinancing rate (%)
rate.help: Taken from the bank's pricing tool and typed in per deal. Three decimal places; there is no default.
rate.invalid: The rate must be a number with at most three decimal places.

valueDate.label: Refinancing start / value date
valueDate.help: The date the refinancing runs from, and the instalment boundary. An instalment falling on this date is not refinanced.

quota.label: Refinancing quota (%)
quota.invalid: The quota must be a percentage between 0 and 100.
quota.overridden: Overridden on this financing. The override is logged.

figures.financingAmountHint: The present value of the refinanced cash flows. This is the figure the Treasury threshold is measured against.
figures.scheduleFinalInstalmentHint: The remaining balance plus the last period's interest. It carries the rounding difference and closes the balance at zero.
figures.quotadResidualHint: The residual value times the quota. A separate figure — it carries no rounding difference and may differ from the schedule final instalment by cents.

pending.title: Figures pending
pending.description: The refinancing rate has not been entered, so nothing is calculated yet. These figures stay pending rather than being computed against an assumed rate.

treasury.title: Above the Treasury threshold
treasury.description: The financing amount is above {{threshold}}. The case is flagged and the notification step applies. This is a warning, not a block — nothing already done is undone.

perContract.title: Per contract
perContract.subtitle: The evidence of what was computed. Each figure is rounded per contract; the package totals above are the sums of these.
perContract.empty: No contract figures have been calculated yet.

rows.committedRate: The committed rate and its expiry
rows.rateField: The rate field — editable until the bank settlement
rows.settlementAndPlan: Settlement and plan — everything, from the loan creation in the core system

terms.title: Terms
terms.subtitle: What you enter here drives the calculation below — change any value and the result updates.

result.title: Result
result.subtitle: Calculated from the terms above. Provisional until the case reaches Committed stage.

staleRate.title: The committed rate ran out before the value date
staleRate.description: It was held for {{days}} days and expired on {{expiry}}, before the value date of {{valueDate}}. Quote it again, or record why it still applies.
